xH.label: Neutral hydrogen fraction
xH.definition: Neutral hydrogen fraction; ionized display weight is derived 1-xH, not electron fraction.

brightness_temperature.label: 21-cm brightness temperature
brightness_temperature.definition: Differential 21-cm brightness temperature including saved spin-temperature and velocity-gradient/RSD effects; signed linear values.
brightness_temperature.qualityNote: Canonical-scroll thermal/ionization driver repaired. Native source-temperature/range and predecessor-chain checks passed. The pristine cold control independently validates density; the pristine matched-perturbation control independently recomputes thermal/ionization history with identical density/velocity inputs, without sharing evolved fields or changing tolerances. This is not independent physical certification.

density.label: Density contrast
density.definition: Matter density contrast δ = ρ / mean(ρ) − 1 from PerturbedField; no log transform.

caveat: Averaged intermediate xH is a cell-volume mean, not a resolved ionization boundary. Same seed is not proof of cross-model phase matching.

comparisonDesign.cause: PerturbField.c rescales float32 IC velocity buffers in place and divides them back; round-trip residuals make regenerated perturbations depend on the preceding redshift calls. Their accepted tiny input differences cross discrete partial-ionization branches. Freeze perturbation inputs when testing thermal/ionization evolution.
